caption: The drawing features a single ceramic pot with an overall light grayish-blue color. The pot is wide with a rounded body, a slightly narrower base, and a wide open mouth. It has two handles, one on each side near the rim, which curve outward and up. The rim is thick and slightly darker in shade. The body of the pot is decorated with a repeating pattern of blue swirls and loops, some forming heart-like shapes, with small clusters of dotted blue accents beneath each design. The background is unadorned and a light beige color, making the pot the central focus of the composition. The shading on the pot suggests a light source coming from the upper left, creating shadows on the lower right side and inside the opening.
title: Stoneware Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
